creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Bloom's taxonomy
Cognitive levels
Learning objectives
Instructional design
dublinCore.description: Interactive stepped pyramid of the six levels of the revised Bloom's taxonomy, from Remember at the base to Create at the apex. Hovering over or tapping a level shows its description and color key.

searchKeywords: remember understand apply analyze evaluate create

learningObjectives: Identify the six levels of the revised Bloom's taxonomy in order, from Remember at the base to Create at the apex
Explain how Understand, which constructs meaning by interpreting and summarizing, differs from Remember, which retrieves facts and terminology
Classify a learning objective into the level whose description fits its verb and task
Differentiate Analyze, which breaks material into parts, from Evaluate, which makes judgments against criteria and standards
Write a Create-level learning objective in which students build or modify their own MicroSim
prerequisites: Having read at least one learning objective

misconceptions.misconception: The verb in an objective decides its level
misconceptions.correction: The same verb can serve different levels; the task and the criteria decide, so read the whole objective
misconceptions.evidence: The Understand description lists comparing, yet objective 14 in the course description (Compare signal processing outcomes...) is grouped under Evaluating

misconceptions.misconception: Only the upper levels of the pyramid matter
misconceptions.correction: Higher levels build on lower ones rather than replace them
misconceptions.evidence: The pyramid stacks every level on Remember, and the Apply description speaks of learned material, which must first be remembered and understood

accessibility.screenReaderScript: Stepped pyramid of Bloom's taxonomy with six levels, from Remember at the base through Understand, Apply, Analyze and Evaluate to Create at the apex. Hover over or tap a level to read its description below the pyramid.

visualElements.description: Stepped pyramid of six equal-height blocks, one per Bloom level, Remember at the base and Create at the apex
Color key with swatch and level name plus the description of the hovered level, or the instruction line when no level is hovered

instructionalStrategies: Tour the levels from base to apex
Classify course learning objectives by level
Write and peer-check a Create-level objective
extensions: Classify the objectives of a chapter quiz by level
Rewrite a Remember-level objective as an Apply-level objective
